# Homepage review — Fernlight (round 3)

Who it is for: Someone in their 20s to 40s with 3-10 houseplants who has lost a few to over- or under-watering and wants a calm helper that does not nag; browsing on a phone in the evening.
Homepage job: Make the reader feel this would keep their plants alive without nagging them, show how a watering schedule is set from their light and the season, and get them to open the sample care plan.
Primary action: See a sample care plan
Fictional study: Fictional design study — there is no app to download and no accounts; the care plan is a sample.

Page: index.html (the homepage), desktop and mobile. A static design built in HTML/CSS; links to other pages are not part of this review. Report problems only.
